description: The mobile week strip. It offers the week's days as buttons; the selected day is aria-pressed and today carries aria-current=date. TmScheduler renders it in the week view on a mobile layout.

parameters.name: Dates
parameters.description: The days the strip offers, in order.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The selected day. The matching button is aria-pressed.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today. The matching button gets aria-current=date.

parameters.name: OnDateSelected
parameters.description: Fires with the day the user picked.
